description: Analyze your tracks with DropTrack directly from ChatGPT and Codex. Upload audio, use an existing DropTrack track, or provide a SoundCloud or Spotify link to inspect structured track analysis and tags, then discover personalized submission opportunities for record labels, DJs, bloggers, and playlist curators. Turn those insights into practical promotion: explore playlists, organize contacts and lists, prepare campaign drafts, review campaign and audience performance, manage advertising and assets, and create press releases, artist bios, and artwork. Every advertised workflow is customer-facing and scoped to the companies, data, and permissions available to your signed-in DropTrack account.

defaultPrompt: Analyze my latest track's audio, AI tags, engagement, feedback, downloads, and submission opportunities.
Compare my track versions using version-specific analytics, comments, and downloads.
Summarize my latest campaign and validate a ready draft without sending or launching anything.
